marker.description: Pink paint applied to a specific structure on the brain surface

main_question: Identify the grey matter of the upper part of the pink structure.
main_explanation: The pink structure is the corpus callosum. The grey matter of the upper part (superior aspect) of the corpus callosum is the cingulate gyrus, which is part of the limbic system.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following is a function of the structure indicated by the pink paint?
options: Transmits sensory information from the body to the brain
supporting_question.explanation: The corpus callosum is the largest white matter tract in the brain and serves to connect the left and right cerebral hemispheres, allowing communication between them.
